title: Retirement already planned — Hayes comparison
summary: The employee had decided to retire before receiving the pension assurance, unlike the causal account accepted in Feinberg.
notes: Which decision or action was induced by the promise? Would changing plans, remaining at work, or foregoing another opportunity alter the analysis? Do not infer reliance merely from receiving the promise before the final retirement date.
